*   **High Emissivity Scaling**: If the image appears too dark due to high-emissivity points scaling the rest of the image, use `sigma_clip` to remove values more than N standard deviations brighter than the mean.
*   **Grey Opacity Mode**: In `grey_opacity=True` mode, colors are mutually opaque (e.g., blue blocks red).
